coverage: Honors College Excellence Scholarship: $13,000 annually (for Honors College invitees)
requirements: Submit the complete application and all required materials by 11:59 p.m. ET on the chosen deadline
Select the Early Action option on the application to qualify for the Nov. 1 date and a Jan. 15 decision
Ensure ACT/SAT scores requested well in advance arrive by the deadline (ACT code 2032, SAT code 1465) if used
Pay the acceptance fee by May 1 to hold the place in the incoming class
Notify the Office of Financial Aid if enrolment is disrupted and request an official leave of absence
Notify the admissions counsellor if a government or private sponsor is paying tuition directly to MSU
documents: Automatic consideration for most awards upon admission
No separate application required for most scholarships
existing.english_requirement: As per Michigan State University undergraduate admission requirements.
application_method: Automatic consideration upon admission application (most awards); Honors College consideration automatic for all MSU applicants
existing.selection_notes: All international students admitted to MSU are automatically considered for the MSU Non-resident Scholarship, which has 'various award levels granted high-achieving students based on their academic performance, with consideration given to the overall rigor and success within their curriculum'. Decisions are released by mid-February. Only a limited number of considered students receive offers and meeting the criteria does not guarantee an award.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving international first-year students seeking merit-based funding at Michigan State University.
existing.notes: Limited number of awards; meeting criteria does not guarantee offer. Awards contingent upon maintaining international residency for tuition. Some scholarships renewable for up to eight semesters. Honors College Excellence Scholarship requires invitation to Honors College.
existing.duration: Renewable for up to eight consecutive fall and spring semesters as an undergraduate
existing.deadline_display: Priority deadline November 1 for early action decision by January 15
existing.program_type: Undergraduate admissions merit scholarships for non-resident international first-year students
